risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to SOFR interest rate fluctuations on its revolving credit facility, but it uses derivative instruments to mitigate this risk. As of December 2025, the interest rate swap has expired.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has limited exposure to foreign exchange rate fluctuations due to its operations being primarily concentrated in the United States.

risks.title: Environmental and Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: As a manufacturer and distributor of wood products, the company is subject to strict environmental laws and regulations regarding forest management and sustainability.

risks.title: Climate Change Risk
risks.score_rationale: Regulations on greenhouse gas emissions and climate policies may affect operational costs and the availability of wood raw materials.

risks.title: Economic and Cyclical Risk
risks.score_rationale: The construction and building materials distribution sector is highly sensitive to economic cycles and real estate market conditions, as reflected by the 4.8% decline in sales in 2025.

ai_positioning.summary: The company BCC does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 2025 10-K filing. The company operates as a building materials distributor and wood products manufacturer, with no apparent technological focus.
